The '''SK-44''' was a model of plasma [[Missile/Legends|missile]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 160 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Its detonation is like the impact of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt, with the power of a missile.<ref name="DC" />
